text:
Elaine: Heads up — the new field-level ownership rollout got rolled back for a subset of accounts. renewal-flag batch also errored on staging. Anyone saw this? /cc @Vik @Jordan
Vik: I can see a rollback marker in the audit trail. owner_id got nulled for ~3k rows during the migration run.
Jordan: Got an alert from the scheduler: `renewal_flagging_job` failed with a constraint error right after the migration.
Maya: Pasting link to the staging logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/renewal/1719004 — shows `ERROR: insert or update on table \"renewal_flags\" violates foreign key constraint \"renewal_flags_owner_id_fkey\"`
Elaine: Huh. The migration added a transitional step that sets owner_id NULL for some cleanup. Maybe the dedupe/cleanup job removed users referenced by accounts.
Vik: Found this in the migration script that ran: ```sql
UPDATE accounts SET owner_id = NULL WHERE last_active < '2023-01-01';
``` — that's way too broad; should've used `AND owner_id IN (SELECT id FROM users_to_remove)`
Jordan: Can we restore owners from the snapshot table? We have a DB snapshot taken just before the run (ts 1718990000).
Maya: Proposed quick rollback plan: restore owner mapping from `accounts_owner_snapshot` and re-run the renewal batch in staging with a pre-check. Script I suggest: ```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE accounts a SET owner_id = s.owner_id FROM accounts_owner_snapshot s WHERE a.id = s.id AND a.owner_id IS NULL;
COMMIT;
```
CSBot: Deploy bot paused pipeline: `renewal-flagging-job` paused at 2024-11-02T10:02Z due to job failure (run id 6912).
Elaine: Ok let's proceed with the restore in staging first. Jordan, can you run the restore and then requeue `renewal_flagging_job`? Tag me when it's done.
Jordan: On it — running restore now. Will report counts.
Jordan: Restore finished. Restored owners: 3,412 rows. Requeued job; job completed with 0 errors in staging. :tada:
Vik: Quick follow-up: we should add a pre-check in the migration pipeline that fails if the migration would null owner_id for accounts with active subscriptions and add a unit test for the migration logic.
Maya: Filed a short ticket: https://rwd/issue/CS-1127 — "migration pre-check + backfill runbook" and assigned to @Vik.
Elaine: Thanks all. I'll run a 30-min postmortem tomorrow 11:00am PST to capture lessons and update the rollout checklist. :white_check_mark:
